text:
Narrative Arc:

Beginning: Sophia, an aspiring musician, struggles with severe stage fright that prevents her from performing and sharing her musical talents with others.

Climax: After finding inspiration and courage through encounters with seasoned artists, Sophia faces her ultimate challenge at a major music festival. This is the pivotal moment where she must confront her fears head-on.

Resolution: Sophia successfully overcomes her stage fright during the festival performance. Her resonant performance captivates the audience, marking the beginning of her rising career.

The transparent material used to make windows is glass.
